Renamed to red_m_sst for inclusion in ; crispred pipeline. ; FUNCTION red_m_sst, az, el, par, DEGREE=deg e = el + (keyword_set(deg) ? 90 : !pi/2) L = red_m_lens(par(0:4)) Re = red_m_rot(e, DEG=deg) Mae = red_m_free_mirror(par(5), par(6), DEG=deg) Ra = red_m_rot(az, DEG=deg) Rfp = red_m_rot(par(11), DEG=deg) Mf = red_m_free_mirror(par(7), par(8), DEG=deg) Ms = red_m_free_mirror(par(9), par(10), DEG=deg) Rfm = red_m_rot(-par(11), DEG=deg) Rlp = red_m_rot(par(13), DEG=deg) Roa = red_m_rot(par(14), DEG=deg) ;; Thats like implemented by Michiel - wrong order of L and Rlp? ;;MM = Roa##Rfp##Ms##Mf##Rfm##Ra##Mae##Re##Mae##Rlp##L MM = Roa##Rfp##Ms##Mf##Rfm##Ra##Mae##Re##Mae##L##Rlp return, MM END
